The following events took place in '''3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]] went bankrupt.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
*[[Canna Omonda]] became [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], replacing [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].
*[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] [[Battle of ThonBoka|saved]] the [[Oswaft]] people.
*[[Tavell Geen]] became [[Scrivinir]] of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]].
*The first recorded encounter with a [[Yarkora/Legends|Yarkora]].
*[[Narg]] was taken over by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
*[[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]] was visited by an organic being for the last time before the [[Imperial Reunification]] [[12 ABY/Legends|fifteen years]] later.<ref name="Darksaber19">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']], Chapter 19</ref>
*[[Shada D'ukal]] joined the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]].<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>
*[[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV's]] residents were displaced by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="TEAp44">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Galen Marek|secret apprentice]] was ordered to hunt down and [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|kill]] the remaining [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name=":0">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
*[[Kota's Militia]] was fragmented due to Starkiller [[Battle of the TIE Fighter Construction Facility|incapacitating]] their [[Rahm Kota/Legends|leader]].<ref name=":0" />
*[[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] was claimed by the Galactic Empire due to the [[First mission to Raxus Prime|death]] of [[Kazdan Paratus]].<ref name=":0" />
*[[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] was further plunged into the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], due to the [[Mission to Felucia (Great Jedi Purge)|death]] of [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]].<ref name=":0" />
*[[Callos]] was [[Bombing of Callos|bombed]] and subsequently devastated.<ref name="TFUn" />
*Starkiller was betrayed and apparently [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Darth Vader aboard the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]; however, Vader had his body secretly retrieved and rebuilt.<ref name=":0" />
*A gala is held in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] for the [[25th anniversary of the settling of the Alderaan Ascendancy Contention|25th anniversary]] of the settling of the [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention]].<ref name="HT">''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets]]''</ref>
*[[Natasi Daala]] is drafted into the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]].<ref name="EGW230">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
